name: drawio
description: This extension brings draw.io directly into Azure DevOps, so you can view, create and edit your diagrams.
author: Yusufmolla

scripts.build: vite build && python scripts/bundle_editor.py && node scripts/generateExtensionManifest.js
scripts.debug: vite build --mode debug && python scripts/bundle_editor.py && node scripts/generateExtensionManifest.js
scripts.package: tfx extension create --root dist --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path dist && node scripts/cleanupDist.js
